FORM 8-K CURRENT REPORT

Apple Inc.

Date of Report: October 31, 2024

Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition.

On October 31, 2024, Apple Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for its fiscal 2024 fourth quarter ended September 28, 2024. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $94.9 billion, up 6 percent year-over-year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $0.97. Diluted EPS was $1.64 excluding the one-off European General Court charge.

Item 5.02 Departure of Directors or Principal Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Principal Officers.

On October 28, 2024, the Board of Directors announced the planned transition of Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri to lead Corporate Services teams effective January 1, 2025, and the appointment of Kevan Parekh as Chief Financial Officer.
